externalNote: Every file this repository reads and may not ship. Each lives under external/, which git and Dropbox both ignore. python3 -m conformance.external reports which are here, which are missing and which are not the file named; SHA-256 alone decides.

sg-1000-1-japan-zip.purpose: One archive of the SG-1000 library the census boots, kept at the path the pack gives it.

canonical_form.notes: The archive itself, because the census and the cartridge runner read it as it is; the census names each image inside by its own SHA-256 in conformance/corpus.json.
